queries.cypher:
MATCH (t:Term) WHERE t.id IN $ids
RETURN t.id AS id, t.name AS name
queries.name: q2h_term_names

queries.cypher:
MATCH (t:Term)-[:IS_A]->(p:Term)
WHERE t.id IN $ids AND p.id IN $ids
RETURN t.id AS child, p.id AS parent
queries.name: q6_termref_edges

queries.cypher:
UNWIND $terms AS t
MERGE (n:TermRef {id: t.id})
SET n.name = t.name
RETURN count(n) AS n
queries.name: f_upsert_termrefs

queries.cypher:
UNWIND $edges AS e
MATCH (a:TermRef {id: e.child})
MATCH (b:TermRef {id: e.parent})
MERGE (a)-[:IS_A]->(b)
RETURN count(e) AS n
queries.name: f_link_termref_edges

queries.cypher:
MERGE (f:Finding {id: $id})
ON CREATE SET f.term_id = $term_id, f.plain_label = $label, f.status = $status,
              f.source = $source, f.onset_months = $onset, f.recorded_at = $at, f.active = true
MERGE (t:TermRef {id: $term_id})
MERGE (f)-[:OBSERVED_AS]->(t)
MERGE (e:Evidence {id: $ev_id})
ON CREATE SET e.kind = $ev_kind, e.quote = $quote, e.start = $start, e.end = $end, e.at = $at
MERGE (f)-[:SUPPORTED_BY]->(e)
RETURN f.id AS id
queries.name: f_add_finding

queries.cypher:
MATCH (e:Evidence {id: $ev_id})
MATCH (s:Story {text_hash: $hash})
MERGE (e)-[:IN_STORY]->(s)
RETURN e.id AS id
queries.name: f_link_evidence_story

queries.cypher:
MERGE (e:Event {id: $id})
ON CREATE SET e.kind = $kind, e.label = $label, e.at = $at
RETURN e.id AS id
queries.name: f_add_event

queries.cypher:
MATCH (f:Family {id: $id})-[:HAS_CHILD]->(c:Child)
RETURN f.id AS id, f.kb_version AS kb_version, f.consent_centre AS consent,
       c.age_months_at_start AS age_months, c.sex AS sex, f.created_at AS created_at
queries.name: f_get_family

queries.cypher:
MATCH (f:Finding)
WHERE f.active = true OR $include_inactive
OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[:SUPPORTED_BY]->(e:Evidence)
RETURN f.id AS id, f.term_id AS term_id, f.plain_label AS label, f.status AS status,
       f.source AS source, f.onset_months AS onset, f.recorded_at AS at, f.active AS active,
       e.quote AS quote, e.start AS start, e.end AS end
ORDER BY f.recorded_at, f.id
queries.name: f_list_findings

queries.cypher:
MATCH (f:Term {id: $fid})<-[:IS_A*0..10]-(x:Term)
WITH DISTINCT x
MATCH (x)<-[r:HAS_PHENOTYPE]-(d:Disease)
WHERE ID(r) >= 0
RETURN $fid AS finding, d.id AS disease, d.prior AS prior, max(r.freq) AS F
queries.name: q2a_exact_or_specific

queries.cypher:
UNWIND $present AS fid
MATCH p = (f:Term {id: fid})-[:IS_A*1..4]->(a:Term)
WHERE a.depth >= 3
WITH DISTINCT fid, a, length(p) AS hops
MATCH (a)<-[r:HAS_PHENOTYPE]-(d:Disease)
WHERE ID(r) >= 0
RETURN fid AS finding, d.id AS disease, d.prior AS prior, a.id AS via, r.freq AS freq, a.bg AS bg_via, hops
queries.name: q2b_broader

queries.cypher:
UNWIND $present AS fid
MATCH (f:Term {id: fid})-[:IS_A*0..20]->(a:Term)
WITH DISTINCT fid, a
MATCH (a)<-[r:LACKS_PHENOTYPE]-(d:Disease)
WHERE ID(r) >= 0
RETURN DISTINCT fid AS finding, d.id AS disease, d.prior AS prior
queries.name: q2c_not_present

queries.cypher:
MATCH (t:Term) WHERE t.id IN $ids
RETURN t.id AS id, t.bg AS bg, t.cx_system AS system, t.ic AS ic
queries.name: q2f_term_meta

queries.cypher:
MATCH (q:Question)
RETURN q.term_id AS term_id
queries.name: f_asked_terms

queries.cypher:
MATCH (d:Disease)-[r:HAS_PHENOTYPE]->(t:Term)
WHERE d.id IN $top AND ID(r) >= 0
RETURN d.id AS disease, t.id AS term, r.freq AS freq
queries.name: q3a_annotations

queries.cypher:
MATCH (t:Term) WHERE t.id IN $askable
RETURN t.id AS id, t.cx_obs AS obs, t.cx_min_age_months AS min_age, t.cx_system AS system, t.cx_question AS question, t.bg AS bg, t.depth AS depth, t.cx_lay_text AS lay, t.cx_plain_label AS plain
queries.name: q3b_askable

queries.cypher:

RETURN f.rule_id AS rule_id, f.level AS level, f.at AS at
ORDER BY f.at
queries.name: f_list_flags

queries.cypher:

queries.name: f_round_count

queries.cypher:

RETURN s.round AS round

queries.cypher:
MATCH (s:Snapshot {round: $round, at: $at})
UNWIND $cands AS c
MERGE (d:DiseaseRef {id: c.id})
SET d.name = c.name
MERGE (s)-[r:CANDIDATE {rank: c.rank}]->(d)
SET r.post = c.post
RETURN count(c) AS n
queries.name: f_add_candidates

CREATE (g:Gate {id: $id, kind: $kind, at: $at, inputs_json: $inputs, rule: $rule})

RETURN g.id AS id
queries.name: f_add_gate

MATCH (f:Term {id: $fid})<-[:IS_A*0..10]-(x:Term)

UNWIND $present AS fid
MATCH p = (f:Term {id: fid})-[:IS_A*1..4]->(a:Term)
WHERE a.depth >= 3
WITH DISTINCT fid, a, length(p) AS hops
MATCH (a)<-[r:HAS_PHENOTYPE]-(d:Disease)
WHERE ID(r) >= 0
RETURN fid AS finding, d.id AS disease, d.prior AS prior, a.id AS via, r.freq AS freq, a.bg AS bg_via, hops
queries.name: q2b_broader

MATCH (f:Term {id: fid})-[:IS_A*0..20]->(a:Term)

WHERE ID(r) >= 0
